clinicalSources.title: ASCIA — Oral food allergen challenges position paper

caption: Test evidence and exposure-related symptoms are separate inputs to assessment of clinical allergy.
question: What does a positive skin-prick or allergen-specific IgE test establish?
answer: It establishes sensitisation; clinical relevance requires interpretation alongside symptoms, exposures and history.
